{{Top}} {{Otheruses|Rake}} {{Image}} {{Character |type=Rebel |image=[[File:Rake.png]] |name=Rake Gahree |homeworld= |birth= |death=[[2 BBY]],Rake Gahree [[Death|dies]] in "[[The Antilles Extraction]]." ''[[Dawn of Rebellion]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars Rebels: Steps Into Shadow]]'' seventeen [[Standard year|years]] after the end of the [[Clone Wars]], which ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Atlas]]'' dates to [[19 BBY]]; therefore, the events of ''Steps Into Shadow'' must taken place in [[2 BBY]]. According to ''[[Star Wars: On the Front Lines]]'', [[Mon Mothma]]'s denunciation of the [[Galactic Empire]] and the [[Declaration of the Rebel Alliance]] take place 2 years before the [[Battle of Yavin]] or [[2 BBY]]. As "The Antilles Extraction" is set between ''Steps Into Shadow'' and "Secret Cargo," Gahree died in 2 BBY. [[Montross]]{{Rebels|The Antilles Extraction}} |species=[[Human]] |gender=[[Gender|Male]]{{RebelsMagCite|33|Sons of the Sky}} |pronouns=He/him |height= |mass= |hair=[[Color|Black]] |feathers= |eyes=Brown |skin=Dark |cyber= |families= |parents=*[[Gahree]] *[[Rake Gahree's parent]] |partners= |siblings=[[Rake Gahree's sibling]] |children= |affiliation=*[[Galactic Empire]] **[[Skystrike Academy]] **[[Imperial Starfighter Corps]] |masters= |apprentices= }} {{Quote|There's no turning back now.|Rake Gahree defects from the Empire|}} '''Rake Gahree''' was an [[Imperial cadet]] at [[Skystrike Academy]] who was friends with both [[Wedge Antilles]] and [[Derek Klivian|Hobbie]]. He and his friends attempted to defect to [[Phoenix Cell]] with the help of rebel agent [[Sabine Wren]]. However, he was killed during the first [[Escape from Skystrike Academy|escape attempt]] when his [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighter]] was destroyed by [[Captain]] [[Vult Skerris]]. ==Biography== ===Early life=== Rake Gahree was [[Reproduction|born]] to two [[parent]]s—[[Gahree]] and [[Rake Gahree's parent|their partner]]—along with a [[Rake Gahree's sibling|sibling]]. ===The rebellion=== Rake Gahree was an [[Imperial cadet]] at the [[Skystrike Academy]], which trained [[Imperial Starfighter Pilot|TIE fighter pilots]]. He was friends with [[Wedge Antilles]] and [[Derek Klivian|Derek "Hobbie" Klivian]]. Two years before the [[Battle of Yavin]], Gahree and his friends became disillusioned with the [[Galactic Empire]] after the Imperials began destroying unarmed rebel ships that had surrendered. They sent a message to [[Phoenix Cell]] that was picked up by the rebel agent [[Fulcrum]]. Fulcrum contacted the Phoenix Cell who dispatched the former Imperial cadet and [[Mandalorian]] warrior [[Sabine Wren]] to extract them. After [[Governor]] [[Arihnda Pryce]] and [[Agent]] [[Alexsandr Kallus|Kallus]] arrived to investigate the presence of defectors at the Academy, Gahree and his two friends talked about the risks involved in their [[Escape from Skystrike Academy|escape]] attempt. Later, Wren met up with Antilles and told him that she had come to rescue him and his friends. An opportunity to escape arose when Governor Pryce and [[Flight instructor|Instructor]] [[Goran]] dispatched all of the cadets on a mock battle exercise. However, this was a trap devised by Pryce to lure the defectors out of hiding. At Wren's direction, the defecting cadets flew their [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter|TIE fighters]] towards a rebel [[CR90 corvette]]. However, Pryce deactivated the TIE's [[solar collector]] panels, leaving the pilots stranded in space. A flight of [[TIE/IN interceptor|TIE interceptors]] led by [[Captain]] [[Vult Skerris]] then attacked the rebel corvette. Under Pryce's orders, Skerris fired a salvo at one of the cadets' TIE fighters; hitting Gahree's craft. Gahree was [[Death|killed]] while his friends and Wren watched. Despite his death, his friends and Wren made a second successful escape attempt. ===Legacy=== {{Quote|What about our ''son''?!"
"You said they ''killed'' him! We want justice!|Rake Gahree's father and mother, to Goran.|}} Antilles and Klivian would later visit Gahree's parents in an attempt to pay their respects to him. However, the pair would swiftly come to realize that their friend's family blamed them for the death of their son, who Gahree's parents wished to take revenge on, growing furious when Antilles and Klivian were offered the chance to return to the Empire by Goran, demanding that they receive justice for Rake's loss. ==Personality and traits== Rake Gahree was a young pilot who joined the Skystrike Academy, which trained starfighter pilots for the Empire. He was friends with Antilles and Hobbie and shared their disillusionment with the Empire's increasingly ruthless policies. This led them to make an escape attempt which led to Gahree's death. He evidently had a close relationship with his father, mother and brother, who desired revenge on Antilles and Hobbie under the misconception that they had been directly responsible for Gahree's death, turning against Goran when he proved willing to accept Rake's alleged 'murderers' back into the Galactic Empire. ==Behind the scenes== Rake Gahree first appeared as a supporting character in the ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]'' episode "[[The Antilles Extraction]]," which first premiered on [[Disney XD]] on [[October 8]], [[2016]] where he was voiced by [[Corey Burton]], who also voiced Instructor Goran in the episode. ==Appearances== *{{Rebels|The Antilles Extraction}} {{1st}} *{{RebelsMagCite|33|Sons of the Sky}} {{Mo}} ==Sources== *{{HelmetCollectionCite|57|Highlights of the Saga}} *{{BuildXWingCite|5|Starfighter Aces}} *{{EncyclopediaCite|Imperial Troops}} {{Po}} *{{Databank|rake-gahree|Rake Gahree}} {{1stID|Gahree}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Rake Gahree#kanon |es=Rake Gahree |fr=Rake Gahree |ja=レイク・ガーリー |ka=რეიკ გარი |pl=Rake Gahree }} {{DEFAULTSORT:Gahree, Rake}} [[Category:Cadets of the Galactic Empire]] [[Category:Humans]] [[Category:Imperial defectors]] [[Category:Imperial Navy pilots of the Galactic Empire]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Males]]
